title: Trash Persona
next_chapter_hook: The Inner Sect emissary's deep eyes narrowed slightly in the shadows. Chen Ji's series of seemingly careless actions had quietly sketched an entirely different profile in his mind—a profile that precisely touched upon the most unwilling-to-be-spyed-on forbidden taboo of the Tianqing Sect.

text.content: While Chen Ji was lost in thought, heavy footsteps suddenly echoed outside the servants' quarters, accompanied by familiarwildly arrogant laughter—Han Lie had actually come in person. That laughter was like thunder rolling over dead leaves, so overbearing it made people's teeth itch. "Chen Waste! This young master is passing by Tianqing Sect today, specifically to see how miserably you're living, the waste among wastes!" The door was kicked open, brilliant sunlight flooding into the dim room, illuminating Chen Ji's calm, water-like face which appeared even more wooden and dull.

Chen Ji blinked, like a fledgling just awakened from a dream, tumbling off the decrepit wooden bed in panic. He wore a dusty servant's robe, the fabric at his knees worn white from friction, covered in grass clippings and dirt. "Han... Han Shixiong?" His voice trembled, lips quivering, his gaze darting as if he'd seen a spirit wronged by King Yama. "Why are you here... I'll, I'll make tea for Shixiong right away!"

dialogue.content: "Make tea? As if a waste like you is qualified to make tea for this young master?" Han Lie looked down condescendingly at Chen Ji curled up on the ground, his eyes filled with nothing but disdain. "Do you know what cultivation stage this young master has reached now? Late Foundation Building! The number one of his generation in Xuanwu Sect! And you? Qi Refining third layer, can't even withstand one of my fingers!"

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, shoulders trembling like withered leaves buffeted by a fierce wind. However, the corners of his mouth slightly curved—a barely perceptible arc—unseen by anyone. Good, late Foundation Building. Not bad, not bad. It seems Xuanwu Sect has piled plenty of resources onto you these past days. But... why does this late Foundation Building aura feel so floating and虚浮? Unstable foundations, forcibly propelled up, right? Chen Ji sneered internally, while maintaining that pitiful appearance on the surface.

Behind Han Lie followed several Xuanwu Sect disciples, each holding their heads high. Among them, a young man with a goatee stepped forward—this was Qian Duoduo, junior brother of Xuanwu Sect's Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. This person had a reputation in Xuanwu Sect for "stepping on others to ascend," most skilled at using the weak as stepping stones to demonstrate his own might. "Han Shixiong, why would someone like this waste be worth your personal visit?" Qian Duoduo sneered阴阳怪气地, "Why not let junior brother teach him a lesson, so he knows the immensity of heaven and earth!"

Qian Duoduo walked over with an overbearing stride, looking down at Chen Ji from above: "Tsk tsk, so this is the famous waste Chen Ji of Tianqing Sect? Tsk tsk tsk, truly the fighter among wastes—even less than waste!" He extended his right foot, casually stepping on Chen Ji's shoulder and grinding down. "Come on, call out for young master a couple times. If you call nicely, young master might spare you!" Chen Ji still cowered, his eyes full of fear—at least that was how it appeared.

Chen Ji timidly raised his head, like a mouse whose tail had been stepped on, squeaking: "Qian... Qian Shixiong, you're magnanimous, this one was wrong, this one won't dare anymore..." His voice was as humble as could be, as pathetic as could be. However, the instant he raised his head, a flash of deep-as-abyss brilliance flickered through his eyes—that was the gaze a hunter directs at prey. Three breaths. Just three breaths was enough to crush this跳梁小丑's ankle bone into a comminuted fracture. But... was it worth it?

choice.prompt: Qian Duoduo was proudly displaying his strength, stepping harder and harder on Chen Ji's shoulder—how should he respond?

choices.description: Maintain the trash persona, let them become arrogant and reveal more flaws
choices.visible_reward: Make enemies even more dismissive, accumulate rage for the later reversal
choices.risk_hint: Physical pain is nothing to Chen Ji

text.content: Chen Ji continued playing his waste role, constantly begging for mercy, his body curling lower and lower, looking like a mouse being toyed with by a cat. Qian Duoduo's smile grew more radiant, his foot pressing harder on his shoulder, as if already seeing his triumphant expression炫耀 this scene before his Xuanwu Sect comrades.

choices.description: Let them know why flowers bloom so beautifully, while still maintaining the facade of the trash persona
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate the small fries, make them hesitate to act
choices.risk_hint: Excessive display might draw unnecessary attention

text.content: The instant Qian Duoduo's foot was about to grind down again, Chen Ji's body suddenly slipped—that movement looked panicked but was actually perfectly timed to avoid the vital point. Qian Duoduo's foot missed, his body lunging forward, letting out an "Aiyo" as he fell flat on his face, knocking out two front teeth on the spot.

Chen Ji chose to continue acting. Seeing that he didn't even dare fight back, Qian Duoduo's interest skyrocketed. He squatted down, grabbing Chen Ji's collar and hoisting him up: "This is it? Tianqing Sect's waste is indeed Tianqing Sect's waste, doesn't even have the courage to fight back!" His voice was sharp and piercing, carrying a perverse sense of pleasure. Several surrounding Xuanwu Sect disciples burst into laughter, some even cheering: "Qian Shixiong, step on him a couple more times! Make him bark like a dog!"

Chen Ji was grabbed by the collar, feet dangling, his expression still appearing terrified. However, his peripheral vision swept toward the doorway— not far away, behind an ancient pine, a cyan figure stood quietly. That was... the attire of an Inner Sect emissary. Chen Ji's heart stirred. Perfect timing. He deliberately struggled a couple times, his sleeve "inadvertently" slipping down a bit, revealing a faint spiritual pattern on his wrist—that was a protective formation automatically formed by the Tianji Record Fragment at a critical moment, fleeting yet subtle, but sharply captured by that cyan figure.

dialogue.content: "Enough." Han Lie finally spoke, his voice carrying a hint of impatience. "He's just a waste, what's so fun about that? Qian Duoduo, don't waste time here.

text.content: Qian Duoduo was having too much fun, how could he be willing to stop? He threw Chen Ji to the ground, raising his foot to stamp on Chen Ji's face: "Han Shixiong, you go ahead, junior brother will be right there! If I don't stomp this waste's face into the mud today, I'll never call myself a man!" Chen Ji lay on the ground, dust covering his cheeks, looking utterly disheveled. Deep in his eyes, however, was a sheet of icy calm. You want your face, do you?

choice.prompt: Qian Duoduo's foot is about to step on Chen Ji's face—this time, should he continue acting?

choices.description: Show mercy and give Qian Duoduo a step to retreat, also earning a reputation for being "kind-hearted"
choices.visible_cost: Holding in a breath of anger
choices.visible_reward: The trash persona becomes even more solid, while gaining a reputation for being "cowardly but kind"
choices.risk_hint: This person might become even more emboldened
choices.process_label: dodge vital strike at last moment

text.content: Qian Duoduo's foot came down heavily, but at the last moment it veered off—Chen Ji "conveniently" turned his face sideways, that kick grazing his ear root and slamming into the ground, shattering the bricks. Qian Duoduo couldn't stop his momentum, stumbling and falling right at Chen Ji's feet, his posture so disheveled it looked like he was performing a kneeling ceremony.

choices.text: Step on him until he questions his life
choices.description: Since you won't take a gift, don't blame me for being impolite—let him know the immensity of heaven and earth
choices.visible_reward: Completely shatter Qian Duoduo's Dao heart, making him walk around Chen Ji from now on
choices.risk_hint: The commotion is too big, might attract more attention
choices.process_label: cold smirk, press hand to ground

text.content: The instant Qian Duoduo's foot was about to land, Chen Ji's right hand quietly pressed against the ground. His fingers flicked gently, a wisp of pure spiritualspiritual energy sliding through the floor tile gaps into Qian Duoduo's ankle—that spiritual power was gentle as a spring breeze caressing willow branches, yet precisely struck the weakest acupoint on his ankle. Qian Duoduo's foot suddenly went numb, his entire body losing balance, flying directly over Chen Ji's head and crashing into the corner wall, raising a cloud of dust.

Qian Duoduo struggled up from the corner, his forehead bruised, blood mixing with dust covering his entire face, looking utterly wretched. "You... you waste dare to sabotage me?!" He trembled with rage, pointing at Chen Ji and screaming. Chen Ji still lay on the ground, his face full of innocence: "Qian... Qian Shixiong, this one didn't do anything... Shixiong just couldn't stand steadily..." His voice was extremely aggrieved, his expression extremely innocent, but hidden in those eyes was unmistakably a hint of playfulness.

The surrounding Xuanwu Sect disciples looked at each other in bewilderment. Clearly it was Qian Duoduo who fell on his own, but they always felt something was off. Han Lie narrowed his eyes, his gaze sweeping over Chen Ji. Although he was notoriously simple-minded, his instincts were unusually sharp. In that instant, he felt something was wrong about this waste, but what exactly, he couldn't quite put his finger on. "Waste, you better behave yourself." Han Lie coldly snorted, turning to leave. However, just then, Chen Ji "inadvertently" raised his head.

That gaze was calm as a still ancient well, profound as if it could see through human hearts. Han Lie's heart suddenly contracted, his footsteps involuntarily pausing. Just for an instant. The next moment, Chen Ji had already returned to his timid, submissive appearance, lowering his head to continue trembling. Han Lie frowned, shaking his head—there must have been an illusion. A Qi Refining third layer waste, what threat could he possibly pose? "Let's go!" He swept his sleeve and departed with the group.

Chen Ji still lay on the ground until those footsteps completely faded away. Only then did he leisurely rise, brushing the dust off his clothes. "Whew... acting is really exhausting." He muttered to himself, a meaningful smile curving his lips. "Qian Duoduo, right? Remembered. That kick of yours, this seat has recorded it." He raised his head, his gaze passing over the courtyard wall of the servants' quarters, landing on the direction of that ancient pine— that cyan figure still stood there quietly.

Chen Ji understood in his heart. An Inner Sect emissary... someone of Su Qingyao's. Interesting. She indeed hasn't relaxed her surveillance on him. But how much did her person see? Chen Ji shrugged indifferently. The aura of the Tianji Record had been concealed by him using special techniques—unless someone witnessed him动用 the power of the Tianji Record, there was absolutely no way to detect it. As for that glance... Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his smile growing deeper. One must give some sweetness, right? Otherwise, how would Su Qingyao, that woman, become increasingly interested?

Not far away, behind the ancient pine, the cyan figure subtly moved. The Inner Sect emissary's expression remained unchanged, but his heart was already churning with immense waves. That waste... something's off. He personally saw Qian Duoduo inexplicably fall flat on his face, personally saw Chen Ji's bizarre gaze switch in front of Han Lie. That kind of gaze was absolutely impossible for a Qi Refining third layer waste to have. That was... the gaze of a superior. The gaze of one who controls everything. The Inner Sect emissary took a deep breath, turning to quietly depart. This news must be reported to Senior Fellow Su as soon as possible.

Meanwhile, inside the Tianqing Sect Council Hall. Ling Yuan sat cross-legged on a meditation cushion with closed eyes, when suddenly he opened his eyes. That pair of murky old eyes flickered with a gleam of light. "Interesting..." he murmured to himself, his withered fingers gently tapping the armrest, "The aura of the Tianji Record... seems to have flickered active again for an instant." A meaningful smile slowly curved his lips. "Chen Ji... Chen Ji... who exactly are you?"

Inside the servants' quarters, Chen Ji suddenly felt a chill run down his spine. He raised his head, gazing toward the direction of the Council Hall, his gaze sinking slightly. Someone was watching him. And this feeling of being watched... didn't come from Su Qingyao's people. It came from a higher place. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, that worldly smile on his face gradually fading, replaced by a deep, cold intent. Ling Yuan... old fox, you're indeed not idling. He gently exhaled, returning to that slovenly appearance, humming a tune as he walked back into his decrepit little house. It doesn't matter. Come then. You want to watch a show, this seat will perform one for you. Only, in the end, whose show is being watched—that's not certain.

Chen Ji closed his door, taking out a dim jade slip from his chest. This was his secret communication token with Ye Qing. He injected spiritual power into it, and several lines of small text appeared on its surface: "Xuanwu Sect movements are frequent, something big might be about to happen. The aura of the Tianji Record Fragment is becoming increasingly obvious, must be especially careful. —Ye Qing" After reading, Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then ignited a wisp of spirit fire with his fingertip, turning the information in the jade slip to ashes. "Interesting..." he murmured, "It seems this game is getting more and more lively."

Outside the window, the setting sun slanted westward, dying Tianqing Sect in a golden red. Chen Ji stood before the window, watching the darkening horizon, his gaze profound as an abyss. Han Lie's provocation was just a beginning. Qian Duoduo's humiliation was just an appetizer. The real storm was still to come. He slowly clenched his fist, and at his palm center, a mysterious pattern flickered indistinctly. Heavenly Fate Value, only seventy-three points remaining. And he still had many accounts to settle. The Chen family. The Holy Sect. Ling Yuan. And that Eye of Heavenly Dao hiding in the shadows. One by one. A cold smile curved his lips, but deep in his eyes was a cold, resolute determination. In this life, he would not lose to anyone again.
